battle.name: 南斯拉夫內戰
battle.brief: 1991年南斯拉夫聯邦在斯洛文尼亞與克羅埃西亞的民族自決運動爆發武裝衝突，標誌著巴爾幹地區多年戰火的開始。此戰場上可見蘇聯授權生產的T-72主戰坦克，該坦克於1971年服役，並在後續的內戰中多次出現。

kit.name: T-72 主戰坦克
kit.history: 作為蘇聯及華約國家的主力裝甲，T-72以堅固的裝甲與125毫米口徑滑膛砲著稱，在南斯拉夫內戰期間被多支派系使用，顯示其在地面作戰中的重要性。

countries: 本錄以1991年1月1日至12月31日為時間界線，把年初克羅地亞的零星武裝衝突、6月27日以後斯洛維尼亞的全面戰鬥，以及夏季至年底克羅地亞、克拉伊納、杜布羅夫尼克和武科瓦爾的戰線放在同一條時間軸上。名義上的中央交戰者是南斯拉夫聯盟及其南斯拉夫人民軍（JNA），但JNA的實際調度、兵源與政治指揮逐步受塞爾維亞方面影響，黑山仍是聯盟軍重要的兵力、炮兵和後勤來源。斯洛維尼亞與克羅地亞由共和國政府、地方防衛軍、警察以及整編後的常備軍作戰；波赫尼亞與黑塞哥維那在1991年主要是聯盟軍駐防與地方防衛軍，而不是另一條已全面展開的主戰線。塞爾維亞人控制的塞爾維亞自治區克拉伊納於10月宣布自治，隨後升格為塞爾維亞共和國克拉伊納，並與聯盟軍第1、第2軍團及地方武裝連成一體。歐洲共同體與聯合國的觀察和調解機構不是作戰方；這個界線使聯盟軍、塞爾維亞當局、克拉伊納和克羅地亞軍隊的指揮責任不會被混為一談。
countriesEn: This record uses 1 January to 31 December 1991 as its time boundary. It places the early sporadic armed clashes in Croatia, the full-scale fighting in Slovenia after 27 June, and the Croatian, Krajina, Dubrovnik, and Vukovar fronts from summer through the end of the year on one chronological axis. The nominal central belligerent was the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia and its Yugoslav People's Army, or JNA, but the army's actual deployment, manpower, and political direction were increasingly affected by the Serbian authorities, while Montenegro remained an important source of JNA troops, artillery, and logistics. Slovenia and Croatia fought through republican governments, Territorial Defence formations, police forces, and the regular armies that were being organized. Bosnia and Herzegovina in 1991 was primarily a location for JNA garrisons and Territorial Defence rather than a fully developed main front. The Serb-controlled Serb Autonomous Oblast of Krajina declared autonomy in October and was then raised to the Republic of Serbian Krajina, connecting its local armed forces with the JNA's 1st and 2nd Army Corps. European Community and United Nations observers and mediators were not combatant forces; this distinction keeps the JNA, the Serbian authorities, Krajina, and the Croatian armed forces from being treated as one command structure.
people: 指揮權與政治責任必須分開追蹤。斯洛維尼亞總統米蘭·庫昌（Milan Kučan）在6月宣言後支持把地方防衛軍整合成能持續作戰的部隊，地方防衛軍指揮官達沃林·克拉什（Davorin Kraš）負責把各市鎮防衛單位接到共和國指揮系統；聯盟軍第4軍團則代表聯盟在西北地區的正式軍事單位。克羅地亞總統弗蘭尤·圖爾季曼（Franjo Tuđman）掌握最高政治與軍事授權，總參謀長茲維奧尼爾·切爾文科（Zvonimir Červenko）負責把警察、地方防衛軍和陸軍整編為軍團體系，後來第7軍團等單位參與東部與南部攻勢。聯盟軍總參謀長維爾約·布拉伊奇（Veljo Bulajić）代表聯盟總部，聯盟軍第2軍團司令斯韋托扎爾·沙伊諾維奇（Svetozar Šajnović）則是武科瓦爾與東斯拉維亞攻勢的主要軍事指揮者。塞爾維亞總統斯洛博丹·米洛舍維奇（Slobodan Milošević）的政治選擇決定了聯盟軍是否繼續維持聯盟框架，前線並不是由單一政治人物直接代替各軍團下達每一道命令。波赫尼亞總統阿利亞·伊澤貝戈維奇（Alija Izetbegović）則在1991年把波黑防衛體系維持在聯盟軍與地方防衛軍的框架內。這些人的權力來源和軍事職責不同，說明同一場戰爭中出現的衝突，不能只用首都的政治聲明解釋。
peopleEn: Command authority and political responsibility have to be followed separately. After Slovenia's June declaration, Slovenian President Milan Kučan supported the integration of Territorial Defence units into a force capable of sustained operations. Brigadier Davorin Kraš, commander of the Slovenian Territorial Defence, worked to connect municipal defence units to the republican command system, while the JNA 4th Army Corps represented the formal federal military formation in the northwest. Croatian President Franjo Tuđman held the highest political and military authority, and Chief of the General Staff Zvonimir Červenko organized the conversion of police, Territorial Defence, and army formations into corps. The 7th Corps and other formations later took part in operations in eastern and southern Croatia. Veljo Bulajić, Chief of the General Staff of the JNA, represented the federal headquarters, while Svetozar Šajnović, commander of the JNA 2nd Army Corps, was a principal operational commander in Vukovar and eastern Slavonia. Serbian President Slobodan Milošević's political choices determined whether the JNA would continue to operate as a federal institution; no single political leader issued every field order in place of the corps commanders. Bosnian President Alija Izetbegović kept Bosnia's defence structure within the framework of the JNA and local Territorial Defence during 1991. These officials had different sources of authority and military duties, so the conflicts in one war cannot be explained only by political statements from the capitals.
kits: 1991年戰場上的重型裝備不是某一方的單一系統。聯盟軍核心主戰坦克是M-84，部分序列有改進型M-84A；聯盟軍分割裝備時，克羅地亞軍接收了其中相當數量。聯盟軍其他裝甲單位還可見M-60A3和M-551，M-60A3裝105毫米砲，M-551裝152毫米砲，而M-84系列使用125毫米砲；同口徑的炮彈也必須按火炮種類分庫。塞爾維亞與克拉伊納的裝甲編制中可見T-55、T-62等較早的蘇系坦克。炮兵方面，M-101 105毫米、D-20 152毫米、M-1A1 155毫米自走炮和2S1 Gvozdika 122毫米自走炮均已在1991年前列裝，並在東斯拉維亞、杜布羅夫尼克方向或克拉伊納前線使用。聯盟空軍可用的MiG-21、MiG-29、J-22 Orao、Mi-8和Mi-24，以及後來由克羅地亞接收的部分MiG-21與MiG-29，構成了有限度的空中支援；它們的出動量受跑道、維修、燃油和飛行訓練限制。地面防空包括SA-2、2K12 Kub及Zastava M55 20毫米機炮，步兵火力則以Zastava M70步槍、RPG-7和DShK 12.7毫米重機槍為核心。實際補給並非只問炮彈數量，125毫米穿甲與高爆彈、105與122及152與155毫米炮彈、20毫米與12.7毫米彈藥，以及MiG-21使用的R-13空對空導彈必須分別儲存；裝甲車履帶、輪胎、柴油、無線電電池和備件的供應同樣會決定連續射擊的天數。以上型號在1991年以前均已列裝，後來才出現的武器沒有被倒灌進這場戰爭。
kitsEn: The heavy equipment available in 1991 did not belong to a single side's standardized inventory. The JNA's principal main battle tank was the M-84, with an improved M-84A appearing in some formations; when the federal equipment was divided, the Croatian army inherited a substantial number of these vehicles. Other JNA armoured formations also included the M-60A3 and M-551. The M-60A3 carried a 105 mm gun, the M-551 carried a 152 mm gun, and the M-84 series used a 125 mm gun. Even weapons of the same nominal calibre had to be stored according to gun type and ammunition specification. Serbian and Krajina armoured formations also included older Soviet tanks such as the T-55 and T-62. The artillery inventory included the M-101 105 mm howitzer, D-20 152 mm howitzer, Yugoslav M-1A1 155 mm self-propelled howitzer, and 2S1 Gvozdika 122 mm self-propelled howitzer, all of which had entered service before 1991 and were used in eastern Slavonia, around Dubrovnik, or on the Krajina front. The JNA air arm had MiG-21, MiG-29, J-22 Orao, Mi-8, and Mi-24 aircraft, while Croatia later inherited some MiG-21 and MiG-29 aircraft. These aircraft provided limited air support, but sortie generation depended on airfields, maintenance, fuel, and pilot training. Ground air defence included SA-2, 2K12 Kub, and Zastava M55 20 mm cannon; infantry firepower centred on the Zastava M70 rifle, RPG-7, and DShK 12.7 mm heavy machine gun. Logistics required more than counting shells. 125 mm armour-piercing and high-explosive rounds, 105, 122, 152, and 155 mm ammunition, 20 mm and 12.7 mm ammunition, and the R-13 air-to-air missile used by MiG-21 had to be stored separately. Tank tracks, tyres, diesel fuel, radio batteries, and spare parts could determine how many days a unit could fire continuously. All these models had entered service before 1991; weapons introduced afterward were not inserted into the 1991 battlefield.
tactics: 1月至5月，聯盟軍巡邏隊與克羅地亞地方警察在帕克拉茨、利皮克、特尼亞和奧西耶克等道路、城鎮入口和橋梁附近反覆接觸；先是小規模步兵交火和炮兵試射，接著聯盟軍以營級部隊封鎖據點，切斷地方防衛軍的車輛與彈藥流動。6月27日以後，第4軍團在斯洛維尼亞沿公路和鐵路節點推進，企圖控制盧布拉那周邊、邊境通道和軍火庫；地方防衛軍利用山地、河流、狹窄道路和既有陣地建立觀察哨，反裝甲小組在坡地及道路彎道攻擊孤立裝甲，炮兵則打擊射界和集結地。聯盟軍分散的縱隊因此無法同時控制所有節點，布廖尼基地在7月1日被地方防衛軍控制後，布廖尼停火安排形成，7月7日前後大規模戰鬥停止。7月8日普利特維采事件顯示聯盟軍與克羅地亞治安部隊的對抗已成為固定前線；夏季聯盟軍第2軍團在斯拉沃尼亞以炮兵、坦克和步兵協同作戰，先以火力固定橋梁、城鎮外圍和補給道路，再試圖壓縮奧西耶克及武科瓦爾守軍的空間。武科瓦爾的克羅地亞守軍利用營區、橋梁和反坦克陣地分散防守，聯盟軍則反覆砲擊並封鎖道路，試圖以兵力集中換取通道；這種戰法把城市攻防變成炮兵、觀察、通信和夜間巡邏的消耗戰。杜布羅夫尼克方面，聯盟軍第37摩托化旅等部隊從Hum、Ljubomir等高地架設炮位，海軍艦艇也參與封鎖和射擊；克羅地亞守軍以分散陣地、雷達觀察和海岸方向的火力反制，因而能承受反覆轟擊。8月2日至5日的閃電行動由特種警察和克羅地亞軍隊從瓦拉日丁、察科韋茨等集結區向普雷克穆列推進，越過穆拉河後切斷聯盟軍的地方聯絡和補給。10月6日至8日的暴風行動則由第1、第4、第5和第7軍團等單位從多個方向同時攻擊，炮兵準備後由裝甲和步兵分別沿公路、鐵路和山間通道推進；克羅地亞部隊遇到堅固據點時繞過或先行隔離，再修復道路、安排燃油和彈藥，因而不是只靠一次正面突破。聯盟軍和克拉伊納部隊在UNA河、利卡和斯拉沃尼亞方向進行反擊，卻未能恢復被切斷的通信和供應線。
tacticsEn: From January to May, JNA patrols and Croatian local police repeatedly encountered one another near roads, town entrances, and bridges in Pakrac, Lipik, Tenja, Osijek, and surrounding areas. The first contacts consisted of small infantry clashes and artillery probing, followed by battalion-sized JNA formations occupying junctions and restricting the movement of vehicles and ammunition. After 27 June, the 4th Army Corps advanced along road and railway nodes in Slovenia, seeking to control the Ljubljana area, border crossings, and ammunition depots. Slovenian Territorial Defence units used hills, rivers, narrow roads, and prepared positions for observation; anti-tank teams attacked isolated armour on slopes and road bends, while artillery targeted firing sectors and assembly areas. Dispersed JNA columns could not control every junction at once. After local forces took control of the Brijuni base on 1 July, the Brioni ceasefire arrangement was formed, and large-scale fighting largely ended around 7 July. The Plitvice incident on 8 July showed that confrontation between the JNA and Croatian security forces had become a fixed front. In summer, the JNA 2nd Army Corps conducted combined-arms operations in Slavonia, using artillery, tanks, and infantry to fix bridges, positions outside towns, and supply roads before trying to reduce the space held by Osijek and Vukovar defenders. The Croatian garrison at Vukovar used barracks, bridges, and anti-tank positions in a dispersed defence. The JNA answered with repeated artillery fire and road blockades, seeking to exchange concentration of troops for access. The battle therefore became a costly contest involving artillery, observation, communications, and night patrols. Around Dubrovnik, JNA formations including the 37th Motorized Brigade placed artillery on high ground such as Hum and Ljubomir, while naval vessels participated in blockade and bombardment. Croatian defenders used dispersed positions, radar observation, and coastal-direction fire to withstand repeated strikes. Operation Flash, from 2 to 5 August, used special police and Croatian army formations from assembly areas around Varaždin and Čakovec to advance into Prekmurje, cross the Mura, and cut local JNA communications and supply routes. Operation Storm, from 6 to 8 October, involved the 1st, 4th, 5th, and 7th Corps striking along several axes. After artillery preparation, armour and infantry advanced on roads, railways, and mountain tracks. When they encountered strong positions, Croatian units bypassed or isolated them before repairing roads and arranging fuel and ammunition, rather than relying on a single frontal breakthrough. JNA and Krajina forces counterattacked in the Una, Lika, and Slavonia directions, but could not restore the communications and supply lines that had already been cut.
data: 關鍵時間線與後勤鏈可以按以下順序核對。1月至5月，聯盟軍與克羅地亞地方警察在帕克拉茨、利皮克一帶出現早期衝突，5月中旬又在特尼亞和奧西耶克交火。6月25日，斯洛維尼亞和克羅地亞議會分別通過獨立宣言；斯洛維尼亞宣言在6月27日成為全面武裝對抗的公開起點，克羅地亞的既有衝突則在月底被置於共和國與聯盟軍的公開對抗中。6月27日至7月7日是斯洛維尼亞十天戰；7月1日達成布廖尼協議，7月3日簽署文本。7月8日普利特維采警察 station遭到聯盟軍攻擊，成為下一階段的直接升級點。7月18日至11月4日，杜布羅夫尼克方向持續遭受炮擊和海上封鎖。8月2日至5日，克羅地亞執行閃電行動，越過穆拉河進入普雷克穆列。9月25日，聯合國安全理事會第713號決議對南斯拉夫實施武器禁運。10月6日至8日，克羅地亞執行暴風行動；10月8日克羅地亞正式宣布獨立。10月16日塞爾維亞自治區克拉伊納宣布自治，10月19日升格為塞爾維亞共和國克拉伊納。11月18日，武科瓦爾克羅地亞守軍向聯盟軍投降，聯盟軍撤離安排延至翌年仍未完全完成。編制上，斯洛維尼亞戰線由聯盟軍第4軍團負責，克羅地亞北線和東線則涉及聯盟軍第1、第2軍團；克羅地亞軍隊以察科韋茨、比耶洛瓦爾、奥古林等地區為主要集結和後勤中心。暴風行動的多條軸線分別向卡爾洛瓦茨、戈斯皮奇、克寧及東斯拉維亞方向推進。斯洛維尼亞的補給依賴聯邦原有軍區庫存、公路和鐵路；克羅地亞則一面接收聯盟軍庫存，一面受制於被切斷的運輸節點。克拉伊納的武裝主要由塞爾維亞經克寧和波黑北部取得補給，暴風行動後這些聯絡線被迫重組。武科瓦爾的包圍作戰使炮彈、柴油、備件和醫療用品只能沿仍可通行的道路輸送；杜布羅夫尼克的海上補給則受到艦艇封鎖影響。125毫米、105毫米、122毫米、152毫米和155毫米炮彈必須按口徑、火砲種類和尾號分庫，柴油與履帶備件不能用同樣方法替代。既有庫存仍能維持一段時間的射擊，但武器禁運使新補充更困難。本段只採用可核對的日期、編制、路線和補給事實，不把各方估算的傷亡數字當成精確總數。
dataEn: The key chronology and supply lines can be checked in the following order. Between January and May, early JNA and Croatian local-police clashes appeared around Pakrac and Lipik, with fighting in the Tenja and Osijek area in mid-May. On 25 June, the parliaments of Slovenia and Croatia adopted separate declarations of independence; Slovenia's declaration became the public starting point for full-scale armed confrontation on 27 June, while Croatia's existing clashes were placed in an open confrontation between the republic and the JNA by the end of the month. From 27 June to 7 July came the Ten-Day War in Slovenia; the Brioni agreement was reached on 1 July and its text was signed on 3 July. On 8 July, a JNA attack on the Plitvice police station became the next direct escalation point. From 18 July to 4 November, Dubrovnik was subjected to artillery fire and a naval blockade. From 2 to 5 August, Croatia carried out Operation Flash, crossed the Mura, and entered Prekmurje. On 25 September, United Nations Security Council Resolution 713 imposed an arms embargo on Yugoslavia. From 6 to 8 October, Croatia conducted Operation Storm, and on 8 October Croatia formally declared independence. On 16 October, the Serb Autonomous Oblast of Krajina declared autonomy; on 19 October it became the Republic of Serbian Krajina. On 18 November, the Croatian garrison at Vukovar surrendered to the JNA, while the withdrawal arrangements remained incomplete and continued into the following year. Organizationally, the 4th Army Corps handled the Slovenian front, while the JNA 1st and 2nd Army Corps were involved in the northern and eastern Croatian fronts. Croatian assembly and logistics centres were located around Čakovec, Bjelovar, Ogulin, and related areas. The several axes of Operation Storm advanced toward Karlovac, Gospić, Knin, and eastern Slavonia. Slovenia relied on existing federal depot stocks, roads, and railways; Croatia both inherited JNA equipment and suffered from severed transport nodes. Krajina obtained most of its supplies from Serbia through Knin and northern Bosnia, and those lines had to be reorganized after Operation Storm. The encirclement of Vukovar meant that shells, diesel fuel, spare parts, and medical supplies could move only along roads that remained open. Maritime supply to Dubrovnik was affected by the naval blockade. 125 mm, 105 mm, 122 mm, 152 mm, and 155 mm ammunition had to be stored according to calibre, gun type, and lot, while diesel fuel and tank spares could not be substituted by the same procedure. Existing stocks still supported a period of shooting, but the arms embargo made resupply more difficult. This section uses verifiable dates, formations, routes, and supply facts and does not treat estimated casualty totals from any side as precise figures.
cause: 這場戰爭的原因有長期的聯邦制度危機，也有短期的軍事觸發。1980年代後期，南斯拉夫聯邦共產黨體制逐漸失去對共和國的控制，各共和國選舉和政治組織開始以新的代表授權運作。斯洛維尼亞於1990年12月23日舉行獨立公投，克羅地亞於1991年2月17日舉行獨立公投；兩地的投票結果把聯邦中央的政治爭議轉成明確的國家地位要求。聯盟軍的問題也不只是武裝數量，而是它究竟服務於聯盟，還是受某一共和國政治領導直接控制。1989年至1990年間聯盟軍在科索沃等地的部署，使斯洛維尼亞和克羅地亞對中央軍隊的性質更加不信任。塞爾維亞當局希望維持一個有集中軍事權力的聯盟，克羅地亞和斯洛維尼亞則要求重新分配軍隊、武器與邊境防衛權，這使原本的軍事編制問題逐漸與國家分裂問題重疊。3月的塞爾維亞與克羅地亞領導人會談未能解決軍隊分配和聯盟權限，6月25日兩地議會通過獨立宣言後，聯盟軍遂以軍事部署回應，地方防衛軍也拒絕交出武器和指揮權。7月以後，聯盟軍第1、第2軍團與塞爾維亞地方武裝在克拉伊納及東斯拉維亞形成新的軍事秩序。歐洲共同體的調解和聯合國的武器禁運都未能在6月阻止衝突；禁運本身是戰爭擴大後的限制措施，而不是最初爆發的原因。因而，1991年的開戰不能簡化成單一總統命令或單一戰鬥事故，而是聯邦權威崩解、軍隊指揮衝突和共和國武裝動員同時作用的結果。
causeEn: The war had both a long-term constitutional crisis and short-term military triggers. In the late 1980s, the Yugoslav communist system was progressively losing control over the republics, while elections and new political organizations began to operate through different forms of representative authority. Slovenia held an independence referendum on 23 December 1990, and Croatia held one on 17 February 1991. Their results turned a federal political dispute into explicit demands about state status. The JNA's problem was not merely its number of weapons, but whether it served the federation or was directly controlled by the political leadership of one republic. JNA deployments in Kosovo and elsewhere during 1989 and 1990 increased Slovenian and Croatian distrust of the central army. The Serbian authorities wanted a federation with centralized military power, while Croatia and Slovenia sought a redistribution of troops, weapons, and border-defence authority, causing military organization and national dissolution to overlap. The March meeting between the Serbian and Croatian leaders did not settle troop distribution or federal authority. After both parliaments adopted declarations of independence on 25 June, the JNA answered deployments with military force, and Territorial Defence units refused to surrender their weapons and command. From July onward, the JNA 1st and 2nd Army Corps and Serb local formations created a new military order in Krajina and eastern Slavonia. European Community mediation and the United Nations arms embargo failed to prevent conflict in June. The embargo was a later constraint after the war expanded, not its original cause. The 1991 outbreak therefore cannot be reduced to one presidential order or one battle incident; it resulted from the simultaneous breakdown of federal authority, conflict over military command, and mobilization of republican armed formations.
impact: 到1991年秋季，戰爭已改變的不只是前線位置，也改變了軍隊的組織和可持續作戰能力。斯洛維尼亞地方防衛軍在十天戰中證明可以依托山地、橋梁和固定砲位抵擋聯盟軍縱隊，促使聯盟軍第4軍團撤出或交出裝備；克羅地亞則利用聯盟軍分割時取得的M-84、M-84A、M-60A3、M-551、炮兵和防空裝備，把原本分散的地方部隊重組成軍團，並建立察科韋茨、比耶洛瓦爾和奧古林等地的後勤節點。聯盟軍的聯邦指揮形式因此逐步失去一致性，部分部隊仍使用聯盟軍名義作戰，另一些則依塞爾維亞或克拉伊納的實際命令運作。閃電行動切斷普雷克穆列的聯盟軍地方聯絡，暴風行動則迫使聯盟軍放棄西斯拉沃尼亞和克拉伊納的大片陣地，撤退至波斯尼亞北部及東斯拉維亞殘餘據點；聯盟軍的戰役縱隊仍可作戰，但補充速度、裝甲維修和通信恢復都落後。杜布羅夫尼克方向的炮擊在11月4日停止，說明炮兵封鎖與海岸防禦可以在沒有全面奪取城市的情況下被打破；武科瓦爾守軍於11月18日投降，則使東斯拉維亞的聯盟軍必須另行處理撤軍和佔領安排。武器禁運限制了新的外部補充，卻沒有立即消除雙方現有庫存，因此1991年的作戰仍能依靠本地彈藥、柴油和備件維持一段時間。軍事層面的直接影響，是雙方都更重視分散後勤、反裝甲觀察、炮兵反制指揮所、空軍維修和道路控制，而不是只依賴正面衝鋒。政治層面上，聯盟軍作為聯盟共同軍隊的合法性受到削弱，克羅地亞軍隊獲得較完整的重型裝備，克拉伊納則建立了獨立的軍事和政治機構。這些變化把1991年的前線成果轉成往後更難以逆轉的軍事結構。
impactEn: By autumn 1991, the war had changed not only the positions on the front but also the organization and sustained operational capacity of the armed forces. Slovenia's Territorial Defence showed that it could use hills, bridges, and prepared artillery positions to stop JNA columns, contributing to the withdrawal or transfer of JNA equipment from the 4th Army Corps. Croatia used the M-84, M-84A, M-60A3, M-551, artillery, and air-defence equipment obtained during the division of the federal army to reorganize dispersed local formations into corps and establish logistics nodes around Čakovec, Bjelovar, and Ogulin. The federal command of the JNA consequently became less consistent: some formations continued to operate under the JNA name, while others followed effective orders from Serbia or Krajina. Operation Flash cut JNA local communications in Prekmurje. Operation Storm forced the JNA to abandon large areas of western Slavonia and Krajina and withdraw toward northern Bosnia and remaining positions in eastern Slavonia. JNA columns could still fight, but their resupply, armour maintenance, and restoration of communications lagged behind. The artillery fire against Dubrovnik stopped on 4 November, showing that an artillery blockade and coastal defence could be broken without a complete assault on the city. The surrender of the Vukovar garrison on 18 November forced the JNA into separate arrangements for withdrawal and occupation. The arms embargo restricted new external resupply but did not immediately remove existing stocks, so operations in 1991 could still be sustained for a period by local ammunition, diesel, and spare parts. The direct military effect was that both sides placed greater importance on dispersed logistics, anti-tank observation, counter-battery fire against command posts, aircraft maintenance, and road control rather than relying only on frontal assault. Politically, the JNA's legitimacy as a common federal army weakened, Croatia obtained a more complete heavy-weapons inventory, and Krajina created an independent military and political institution. These developments turned the military results of 1991 into structures that were increasingly difficult to reverse.
result: 截至1991年12月31日，軍事結果是斯洛維尼亞境內的聯盟軍主力已經撤出或交出裝備，斯洛維尼亞的獨立成為既成事實；克羅地亞在閃電行動和暴風行動後重新控制包括斯拉沃尼亞大部分在內的廣大區域，但克拉伊納仍掌握克寧、 利卡及西南部若干據點，聯盟軍也仍控制巴拉尼亞和武科瓦爾周邊的部分陣地。杜布羅夫尼克的炮擊在11月4日停止，武科瓦爾守軍在11月18日投降，但撤離和城市交接沒有在年底前全部完成。克羅地亞於10月8日宣布獨立，聯盟軍作為南斯拉夫共同軍隊的實際統一性則已明顯瓦解，部分單位轉而受塞爾維亞或克拉伊納控制。武器禁運、歐洲共同體調解和聯合國觀察安排縮減了談判空間，卻沒有在1991年形成涵蓋所有前線的永久停火。傷亡總數不能負責任地給出一個單一精確值，因為陣亡通知、戰俘名冊、各方戰報和統計口徑並不一致；本錄只保留可核對的日期、投降、佔領和前線變化。由此看，1991年階段的結果是斯洛維尼亞完成軍事分離、克羅地亞取得大部分領土但未完成全國戰線統一、克拉伊納建立持續作戰的武裝，而聯盟軍的聯邦使命則未能在這一年完成。
resultEn: By 31 December 1991, the military result was that the main JNA forces in Slovenia had withdrawn or transferred their equipment, making Slovenian independence a accomplished fact. After Operation Flash and Operation Storm, Croatia had regained a broad area including most of Slavonia, but Krajina still held Knin, Lika, and several positions in the southwest, while the JNA still controlled parts of Baranja and the area around Vukovar. The artillery bombardment of Dubrovnik stopped on 4 November, and the Vukovar garrison surrendered on 18 November, but withdrawal and the handover of positions were not fully completed by the end of the year. Croatia declared independence on 8 October, while the JNA's practical unity as a common Yugoslav military force had clearly broken down, with some formations coming under Serbian or Krajina control. The arms embargo, European Community mediation, and United Nations observation arrangements reduced the space for negotiation but did not create a permanent ceasefire covering every front in 1991. A single precise total of military and other casualties cannot responsibly be given because notification lists, prisoner records, official reports, and statistical definitions differ. This record therefore retains only verifiable dates, surrenders, occupations, and front-line changes. The result of the 1991 phase was a military separation completed in Slovenia, substantial territorial recovery by Croatia without complete national front-line unification, a Krajina force capable of continuing operations, and the failure of the JNA's federal mission to be completed during that year.
